evidence.excerpt: In a match of several games, the loser of the previous game chooses who takes the first turn.
If the previous game was a draw, the player who made the choice in that game makes the choice in this game.
Unlike two-player games, multiplayer games can continue after one or more players have left the game.
If a player loses the game, that player leaves the game. If the game is a draw for a player, that player leaves the game.
